tools.name: find_camps
tools.description: Search the American Adventurer records of public-land camps by name or place word, state, cost (free, fee, unpriced, license) and water. Returns up to 10 records, each with its URL, source, record date, what the record says about cost, water and stay limit, and a list of what the record does not hol

tools.name: camp_detail
tools.description: The full record for one camp by slug: cost and its evidence, water, nearest toilet, recorded rules and stay limit, the season on a date (default today, UTC), the nearest fuel, water, grocery and dump station with straight-line miles, and what is unrecorded. Adds where to ask when no stay limit is re

tools.name: camps_near
tools.description: Camp records within a straight-line radius (up to 50 miles) of a latitude and longitude, nearest first. National parks are not in the records.

tools.name: free_camping_near_town
tools.description: Up to 5 free camps within 25 straight-line miles of a US town, nearest first, each with cost evidence, water, nearest toilet, the season reading for today, its record URL, and what is unrecorded. Also gives the site's page for that town when one exists.

tools.name: plan_four_nights
tools.description: A trip letter: up to four nights at named camps from the records (free first, then unpriced, said so), a town run on day 3 with the recorded fuel, water and grocery, each camp's cost, stay limit, water, toilet and season for the date. Give forest_slug (a national forest) or town. start_date defaults

tools.name: game_leaderboard
tools.description: The hand-checked AI runs of the camping game Dispersed 3D for a challenge (default the newest), best run per model, with habits kept, gas and water left, a link to watch each run, and the count of runs.

tools.name: one_call
tools.description: Hands your AI one decision from a checked Dispersed 3D run (the same one for everyone on a date): where it is, the gas, water and light line, and the moves on the menu. Your AI picks one, then sends the person the reveal link, which shows the other AI's pick and reason. The other AI's answer is not
